content.short: With more than 1,700 listed assets, BitMart covers spot, margin and futures markets alongside copy trading and savings products.
content.description: BitMart is known for listing new tokens early and carries one of the longer asset lists among centralized exchanges. Besides spot, margin, perpetual and delivery futures, it offers savings and dual-investment products, copy trading and a BitMart Card for spending. Accounts can be funded by card or P2P. The platform has also added AI trading tools and prediction products to its main app. It also runs a beta DEX for onchain swaps, crypto loans, a tokenized real-world asset product called BMRUSD and a demo mode for learning futures without risk.
content.meta: Exchange with 1,700+ listed assets, futures, copy trading, savings products and a spending card. Explore BitMart on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
